γνοίη: γιγνώσκω — come to know, recognise; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a negative purpose clause after μή: ’lest he or she recognise’
κάμῃσι: κάμνω — toil, work hard; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -σι (= Attic κάμῃ), in a general relative clause
λυγρῆς: λυγρός — bitter, baneful; fem. gen. sg.
νεφέεσσι: νέφος — cloud; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
ξείνων: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the strangers’ · also partitive gen. after a vocative: ’among strangers, of strangers’ (δαιμόνιε ξείνων ’strange one among guests’)
φάει: φάος (φῶς) — light; neut. dat. sg., epic (= Attic φωτί): ’in the light’
φραζώμεθα: φράζω — consider, devise; pres. subj. mid. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us consider’
χεῦεν: χέω — pour; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (contrast augmented ἔχευε)
ἀπαγγείλειε: ἀπαγγέλλω — report back, announce; aor. opt. act. 3 sg., potential with κεν: ’she could report’
ἀπονόσφιν: ἀπονόσφιν — far away, apart from; adv./prep. + gen.: ’far from’ (φίλων ἀπονόσφιν ’far from his dear ones’)
ἐτώσια: ἐτώσιος — to no purpose, vain, fruitless; neut. nom./acc. pl., used as predicate or adverb
ἐϋκτιμένης: εὐκτίμενος — well-founded, well-settled; fem. gen. sg., epic ἐϋ- (= Attic εὐκτιμένης), agreeing with Ἰθάκης
ἔλαβεν: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg. act. (ν-movable)
ὁρόωντες: ὁράω — see, look at; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὁρῶντες)
